pages.text: Saint John, one of Jesus' friends, wrote a letter, too. He said, "God is love. God showed His love by sending His Son into the world."
"We love because God loved us first." Jesus gave His life for us, and that is how we know how much God loves us.
"If we love one another, God lives in us." We can show God's love to the people around us every day.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God made us in His image, and God is love. When we love one another, we show who God is.
